title: Run
description: Skeleton shape of a Minion run document and its per-step children. Minimal on purpose — the full model lands in F-003. Source of truth for Firestore docs (Minion) and the supervision listener (PWA).

date.description: Run date in YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Paris). Idempotency key.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run began.

endedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run finished; null while running.

name.description: Step name (e.g. gmail, jina, generate, imagen, github).

error.description: Error message if the step failed; null otherwise.
